name: Rust Web Application
author: YmoT@tuta.com
description:
Pterodactyl Egg for running Rust web applications with Git deployment, cron jobs, Let's Encrypt certificates, Cloudflare Tunnels, signed automatic updates and log management.

Features:
- Pre-installed Rust toolchain (stable/nightly)
- Git module: clone your app on install and pull it on every start
- Cron jobs with a built-in cron engine
- SSL certificates via Certbot (DNS-01)
- Cloudflare Tunnel support
- Automatic updates with signed manifests
- Log cleanup module

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Rust Web Egg Installation Script
apt update
apt install -y curl git wget

cd /mnt/server

# Add VERSION file
wget -q -O - https://api.tavuru.de/version/Ym0T/pterodactyl-rust-web-egg | grep -o '"version":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4 | head -1 > /mnt/server/VERSION

# Clone the default repository into a temporary directory
echo "[Git] Cloning default repository"
git clone https://github.com/Ym0T/pterodactyl-rust-web-egg /mnt/server/gtemp > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[Git] Error: Default repository clone failed."; exit 21; }

# Copy necessary files
cp -r /mnt/server/gtemp/modules /mnt/server
cp /mnt/server/gtemp/start-modules.sh /mnt/server
cp /mnt/server/gtemp/LICENSE /mnt/server
chmod +x /mnt/server/start-modules.sh
find /mnt/server/modules -type f -name "*.sh" -exec chmod +x {} \;

# Remove temp directory
rm -rf /mnt/server/gtemp

# Create necessary directories
mkdir -p logs tmp data bin

# Clone or update the user repository if GIT_REPO is set
if [ -z "${GIT_REPO}" ]; then
    echo "[Git] GIT_REPO is not set, skipping."
else
    GIT_BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-}"
    GIT_URL="${GIT_REPO}"

    # Without credentials and .git, so different spellings of the same repo match
    plain_url() { echo "$1" | sed -E 's|^(https?://)[^@/]*@|\1|; s|/$||; s|\.git$||'; }

    if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
        echo "[Git] Using authenticated Git access."
        GIT_URL="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(plain_url "${GIT_REPO}" | sed -E 's|^https?://||')"
    else
        echo "[Git] Using anonymous Git access."
    fi

    if [ -d /mnt/server/app/.git ]; then
        # Reinstall: update the existing checkout instead of deleting it
        cd /mnt/server/app || exit 1
        ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url)
        if [ "$(plain_url "${ORIGIN}")" != "$(plain_url "${GIT_REPO}")" ]; then
            echo "[Git] Error: app/ contains a different repository, leaving it untouched."
            exit 13
        fi
        git remote set-url origin "${GIT_URL}"
        if [ -n "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
            echo "[Git] Updating branch '${GIT_BRANCH}' in app/"
            git fetch --prune origin "${GIT_BRANCH}" > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[Git] Error: git fetch failed for branch '${GIT_BRANCH}'."; exit 12; }
            git checkout "${GIT_BRANCH}" > /dev/null 2>&1 || git checkout -b "${GIT_BRANCH}" "origin/${GIT_BRANCH}" > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[Git] Error: git checkout '${GIT_BRANCH}' failed."; exit 12; }
            git pull --ff-only origin "${GIT_BRANCH}" > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[Git] Error: git pull failed for branch '${GIT_BRANCH}'."; exit 12; }
        else
            echo "[Git] Updating app/"
            git pull --ff-only > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[Git] Error: git pull failed."; exit 12; }
        fi
        cd /mnt/server
    elif [ -d /mnt/server/app ] && [ -n "$(ls -A /mnt/server/app)" ]; then
        echo "[Git] Error: app/ contains files but no Git repository, leaving it untouched."
        exit 11
    else
        echo "[Git] Cloning user repository into app/"
        if [ -n "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
            git clone --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" --single-branch "${GIT_URL}" /mnt/server/app > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[Git] Error: git clone failed (branch '${GIT_BRANCH}')."; exit 14; }
        else
            git clone "${GIT_URL}" /mnt/server/app > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[Git] Error: git clone failed."; exit 14; }
        fi
    fi
fi

echo "[DONE] Installation complete!"

variables.name: Startup Command
variables.description: The command to run your Rust application (e.g., ./target/release/myapp or cargo run --release)

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: Git repository URL that gets cloned into app/ on installation (leave empty to skip)

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to clone and pull. Leave empty for the repository's default branch.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Username for private repositories (used together with the access token).

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description:
Password to use with git.

It's best practice to use a Personal Access Token.
https://github.com/settings/tokens
https://gitlab.com/-/profile/personal_access_tokens

variables.name: Enable Git Module
variables.description: Set to 1 to run git pull in app/ on every start, before your application is built and started.

variables.name: Enable Auto-Update
variables.description: Automatically check for updates on startup

variables.name: Force Auto-Update
variables.description: Automatically download and apply updates without confirmation

variables.name: Enable Cloudflare Tunnel
variables.description: Set to true to start the Cloudflared tunnel on container startup

variables.name: Cloudflared Tunnel Token
variables.description: The authentication token for Cloudflare Tunnel (typically starts with "ey...")

variables.name: Enable LogCleaner Module
variables.description: Enable automatic log cleanup on container startup

variables.name: Enable Cron Module
variables.description: Enable the built-in cron engine for scheduled tasks (edit /home/container/crontab)

variables.name: Enable Certbot SSL
variables.description:
Enable automatic SSL certificate management with Let's Encrypt Certbot

0 = false (default)
1 = true

variables.name: Certbot Email
variables.description: Email address for Let's Encrypt certificate notifications and recovery

variables.name: Certbot Domain
variables.description: Primary domain name for SSL certificate (e.g., example.com or subdomain.example.com)

variables.name: Certbot Staging Mode
variables.description:
Use Let's Encrypt staging server for testing (does not count against rate limits)

0 = Production (default)
1 = Staging/Testing

variables.name: Certbot Force Renewal
variables.description:
Force certificate renewal even if currently valid (useful for testing)

0 = Only renew when needed (default)
1 = Always force renewal

variables.name: Rust Log Level
variables.description: Rust logging level (error, warn, info, debug, trace)
